headline: Big drop in silver prices! Silver rate falls this much in Delhi, UP and Bihar
summary: Silver prices fell sharply on the first day of the week, becoming 7,560 rupees cheaper, according to a Hindustan report on rates in Delhi, UP and Bihar. Prices tend to fall during Pitru Paksha as fewer people buy precious metals.
why: Silver is a precious metal used both as a store of value and in industrial applications such as electronics and solar panels, and its price is closely tracked in India, a major consumer market.

impacts.name: Silver
impacts.why: The report describes a fall in the local silver rate in Indian cities, which reflects lower domestic silver prices.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
